text:
emma (AE): kicking off Solstice Health POC thread. Requirements: SSO (SAML) with signed+encrypted assertions, SCIM group + role mapping, RBAC role enforcement, strict tenant domain-locking (they want wildcard subdomain lock). 2-week eval window, want to start Mon. who owns blockers/pricing?
emma (AE): attached their security questionnaire and metadata link. cc @priya for setup, @tom for sec answers, @jordan for SOW/pricing, @maya for legal notes.
priya (SE): on it. quick checks: we can support encrypted assertions but need to confirm ACS needs to be behind their proxy (terminating TLS) vs our public ACS. also SCIM: they need a bulk-import of ~15k users to seed, plus incremental sync. important: they mentioned SCIM rate limits and retries.
tom (Infosec): sec q highlights: algorithm requirements (rsa-sha256), cert rotation policy, assertion TTL, encrypted assertions required, SCIM TLS mutual auth? they also want audit log retention 1 year and evidence of SOC2.
jordan (CS): pricing: propose covering bulk-import effort under evaluation credits; SCIM connector included on enterprise; for Hosted POC we can waive connector fees. Dedicated quote for production. Also note potential charge for mTLS if they require it.
maya (Legal): they flagged data residency + HIPAA clause. Solstice is a healthcare customer; need BAAs + amendments for PHI handling. legal lead time may delay prod conversion but not POC if we scope data pseudonymization.
priya (SE): for wildcard domain lock: our DNS TXT apex check handles base domains, but wildcard subdomain enforcement requires us to add a verification step (proof of control for wildcard) — ops team may need eng time. workaround: explicit tenant binding + SAML integration scoped to their tenant during POC.
emma (AE): timeline: need confirmation on cert rotation, mTLS, and BAA by Fri EOD to start Mon. action items: priya -> ACS/proxy notes + SCIM bulk plan + throttling/backoff doc; tom -> questionnaire answers + SOC2 artifact pointer; jordan -> SOW + pricing + evaluation credits; maya -> BAA pre-reqs and minimal PHI scoping.
priya (SE): I'll run a staging dry-run of bulk import and post sample logs. staging-bot will show deploy status.
staging-bot: job started: scim-bulk-import v0.9 -> staging cluster.
priya (SE): dry-run complete — sample: IMPORT SUCCESS users=1200/15000 batchSize=500 rateLimit=100req/min backoff=expo. will add recommended retry window and linear backoff config to gdoc.
tom (Infosec): short answers: signing alg = rsa-sha256, assertion TTL = 5m recommended, cert rotation = 90d recommended or customer-managed certs supported for enterprise; mTLS for SCIM available as enterprise add-on; audit logs can be retained 1y on enterprise retention plan. will upload doc.
jordan (CS): SOW draft ETA tomorrow AM. will include manual tenant bind fallback and fee waiver for bulk-import during POC. include HIPAA scoping note.
emma (AE): I'll reach out to Solstice ops for DNS admin contact and legal lead. thanks team. :thumbsup:
